title: viola × cordifolia
intro: Viola × cordifolia, commonly known as heartleaf or heartleaf violet, is a hybrid plant species within the Viola genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving antioxidant activity, thus contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions attributed to Viola × cordifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
